htmlBody:
Race day — today’s tip is Prime-Vault vs ColabFold: three FastA tiers (Ubiquitin · IL-2 complex · orphan/synthetic) with ColabFold as the AlphaFold-class lane (COLABFOLD_LIVE=1). Honesty: no invented pLDDT in CI. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

If you want a map for that: Prime vaults vs ColabFold — the race results. Also new on the board: Sing, Muse, of the Omniversal Lattice.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
